title: Analysis code and results for lineage-selective cancer dependencies from DepMap 26Q1

creators.name: Li, Ranfei
creators.affiliation: School of Biological Sciences, Universiti Sains Malaysia, George Town, Penang, Malaysia

description: Code, intermediate results, figures and supporting tables for the manuscript 'A selectivity-based analytical strategy for identifying lineage-selective cancer dependencies from DepMap data'. The current analysis uses DepMap 26Q1, 1,192 cancer cell lines and 467,091 gene-lineage tests, yielding 94 prioritised pairs. Input datasets are public but are not included in this archive; download instructions and input-file checksums are in the README. Version 2.2.0 adds a Hodges-Lehmann sensitivity analysis of all 9,805 significant gene-lineage pairs and an extended S9 Table. The median-based prioritisation rule remains the primary analysis; the matched HL threshold is post hoc. Version 2.3.0 adds a check of whether the lineage signal is confounded by the per-cell-line screen dynamic range of Chronos, and reports p-values in Fig 13 to two significant digits. Version 2.4.0 adds a formal test of the prioritisation thresholds (S12 Table), a comparison of the prioritised pairs with next-generation patient-derived model screens (S13 Table), and pre-specified and post hoc checks of FERMT2 in CNS/brain (S14 Table); these analyses were added after the primary results were known. Version 2.4.1 changes figure presentation only: in Fig 13 the text boxes no longer hide the lower confidence limits in panel C or data points in panel F, and panel E states the gene set of the co-dependency analysis; p-values in Figs 8 and 9 use the same notation as the other figures; and labels use British spelling. No number, table or result changed.
